name: CMIP6 multi-model daily surface temperature simulations
model_or_instrument: 9 CMIP6 models (AWI-CM1-1-MR, CanESM5, CESM2-WACCM, EC-Earth3-Veg-LR, IPSL-CM6A-LR, MIROC6, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MRI-ESM2-0, NorESM2-MM)

scales.note: Regridded daily global surface temperature fields on a 64x128 grid (~250 km) covering 1850–2100 across 9 CMIP6 models and 3 SSP scenarios.
